levels.title: Script: run on the flag, speak (with a/t Scratch)

hints.text: The project should be run by clicking on the green flag.
hints.title: Add a command to start the project

hints.text: The bear should say "Hello!" within 3 seconds.
hints.title: Add a command for the bear to speak.

presentation.title: See how the project should work

hints.text: The "When the green flag is pressed" command starts the script.
hints.title: Start of the script

hints.text: This command will help you to set a specific costume. We have two different costumes set.
hints.title: Setting the costume

hints.text: The snake sees the dinosaur in a second instead of immediately. To prevent it from changing its costume ahead of time, we use the "wait __ sec" command
hints.title: Expectation

presentation.text: The snake first wriggles, then sees the dinosaur, is surprised, and then straightens its body. How do we program this?
presentation.title: Dinosaur and snake

hints.text: The "When the green flag is pressed" command starts the script.
hints.title: Start of the script

hints.text: The "Next Costume" command changes the costume that is set next in the list of costumes.
hints.title: Costume change

hints.text: For the sprite to perform an action multiple times, you need to use the "Repeat __ times" command. In the window, you can set the number of repetitions.
hints.title: Repeating actions

hints.text: Oops! If we use the "Next costume" command multiple times in a row, the costumes will change too quickly and we will not see how they change: it will be like nothing is happening. To prevent commands from being executed almost simultaneously, we insert a "pause." To do this, we need the "Wait __ sec" command.
hints.title: Expectation

tutorial.text: Add an appropriate background and delete the current one.

presentation.text:
Take a look at the example. The heart changes costume 4 times. Each costume is visible for 1 second.

Can you do the same?
presentation.title: The "Heart" project

hints.text: To make an action repeat itself constantly, use the "Repeat Always" command.
hints.title: Constant repetition

hints.text: You can make the movements smoother by setting a wait before each costume change. We can set the wait time. Try setting it for 0.1 seconds! This command is already ready — just put it in the right place.
hints.title: Smooth movements

presentation.text: Program a costume change so that it seems like the bear is constantly walking! See the example.
presentation.title: The bear walks

tips.title: If you accidentally delete the script
tips.description: Simultaneously press the "CTRL" and "Z" keys in the lower-left corner of the keyboard.
